company_info.company_description: "Our success hinges on the trust of our customers. With numerous successful installations, we prioritize your needs. Every step of the process, from consultation and planning to installation and upkeep, centers around you. We ensure a smooth transition to solar energy, tailored to your preferences and budget."

reviews.review_description: Excellent installation, all done in a day, system set up and grid connection were all taken care of. The installers( Leigh & the boys) were efficient and polite and most definitely knew what they were doing  Communication with Green Vision Solar was all done by Email (not very personal) As I'm a pensioner I found it difficult. But we got there in the end.
Very smooth process and great customer service. Highly recommend Green Vision Solar and their Installer.
From the start to completion, the crew at Green Vision Solar were great to deal with.Great product with amazing service and communication.Highly recommended.

We recently had a large and complicated battery system installed by Green Vision Solar and they did a brilliant job. It was far from easy but they worked through every issue without ever compromising on quality. Really appreciate them getting such a difficult job done and getting it done so well. Would definitely recommend them to others.
Very happy with the service they were very punctual and the installers did a fantastic job. Will definitely recommend.
Oliver helped me from start and beyond with information and support to achieve the system I wanted. A1 customer service!! Since installation the system has been amazing. Very happy

Few months after installation I realised that the installed Fronius inverter didn't have the correct front cover. The model in the quote was GEN24 8.0 Primo, but the cover was labelled Symo (3-phase variant of the GEN24 8.0), The sticker on the side of the device was all about GEN24 Primo. I could not get an explanation for the mix-up from the installer, electrician, or Fronius Australia and suggested that Fronius would provide a replacement front cover saying "Primo" and Green vision would install it.  Fronius made the delivery to my home September 23, 2025 and I am still waiting for Green Vision to send somebody to install. The response to my repeated queries about installation date is "we will call you once we have the date available"

Quote was good. Was kept informed about the installation even though it was delayed slightly. Very efficient installers, was inspected and operational within 2 days of installation Everything was done when they said it would be.
Communicated with Oliver over a year before getting solar and battery installed. Always helpful and accommodating of my queries. All issues sorted with great communication and fairness in mind.

Process was fairly smooth, able to answer my questions promptly, and explain rationale.Installer was punctual and tidy.Customer service was smooth, but would have liked a bit more information about the steps of the whole process.

Quoting and sales process was smooth and easy.  Oliver's communication was very good (included a site visit).The installation went well. The subcontractor Mark and team from Seam Electrical did well and were very accommodating and helpful.The overall customer service was good.I recommended Green Vision Solar to my brother-in-law.   I understand he also had good dealings with Oliver and a Sigenergy system has now also been installed at his place in a surprisingly short time.

Oliver responded to my enquiry very quickly and ran through my requirements before sending an itemised quote promptly. Being new to the Sigenergy system, he was very patient with my change of specifications until I finally worked out what we really needed for our household. Having three phase in my household, it took some time to understand how the Sigenergy Energy Controller works as a full backup solution.We paid our deposit at the end of May, confirmed our final specification mid June and finally got the system installed end of July. It was delayed a few times because of the widespread Sigenergy stock issues which was expected. Both Carla and Oliver kept me in the loop until installation day.On the day, Leigh and his apprentice installed the battery and did an amazing neat job. Having a brick veneer house, they were able to hide all but one cabling behind the walls so at the end the installation looks fantastic. Leigh is probably the cleanest sparky I've dealt with, cleaning up all the mess they made before they left.The Sigenergy system requires after installation support as well, being new to the system and Sigenergy being new to the industry we were able to resolve minor issues together and Oliver was very responsive each time.After all that, the system is running exactly as how it should be. There are some minor issues with the MySigen app not quite correctly showing net metering data correctly but it doesn't affect general everyday use.Between the three options I had at the beginning, I wouldn't hesitate to ask Oliver to install my system again.

I recently had a 40kW 3-phase solar system installed by Green Vision Solar, and I am beyond impressed with both the quality of the system and the service provided. From start to finish, the entire process was seamless.The system itself is fantastic — the quality of the panels and setup is top-notch, and I can already see the savings on my energy bills. The team, led by Oliver, was incredibly professional. He was punctual, ensuring everything was done on time and to perfection. The installation was completed quickly and efficiently, without any unnecessary delays.Oliver and the team took the time to explain how the system works, and I felt confident in my decision from the moment I signed up. It's clear that Green Vision Solar prioritizes quality and customer satisfaction.If you're looking for a reliable, efficient, and professional solar company, I highly recommend Green Vision Solar. They’ve made the switch to solar energy easy and stress-free

Green Vision Solar were incredibly fast getting back to me when I initially reached out for 3 quotes, through Solar Quotes. The teams communication and customer care is first rate. Oliver listened to what we required and came up with a great design. There were frustrations with supply timelines but this was an industry wide issue due to the battery rebate and subsequent high demand Australia wide. Again, communication was excellent and always polite. There quote was cheaper by $1,000's and there deposit was on 10% despite the uncertainty of the rebate when then order was submitted. I wondered whether Green Vision Solar was too good to be true, their reviews said that they were and I confess I was wary but they have done everything they said they would do and with a very high level of service.The installation in the end, was very quick and they did a very neat job and cleaned up after themselves. I was shown how to download, log into and use the app. Again, all first rate service.We are in the process of grid connection. There was a small error in the submission of the paper work but this was rectified within 15 minutes once it was discovered! We are only human and the 15 minute correction was extraordinarily fast.Green Vision Solar know how to run a business. Oliver and his team are fantastic, as is Leigh with his installation team.

Seam Solar & Batteries, the subcontractor to GVS for my job, overcame some hiccups on the day but still completed the installation speedily. Paper warfare was all handled smoothly by GVS. We would use them again.

Green vision and Oliver were fantastic to deal with. At no point was I given a sales pitch. He wasn’t trying to move the brands that offer him best commission.When I asked for quotes I had done some research and I had an idea of the system I wanted. Oliver listened, offered suggestions and gave me the system I wanted. And price wise he was one of the better ones.Or you went someone who doesn’t try to sell you snake oil Oliver is the way to go. He’s the real deal.
Very fast, efficient and a very professional organisation. I have recommended them before and will again.

Oliver at Green Vision always returned my call. Oliver worked through every issue and was always courteous and patient. His solar knowledge is comprehensive and accurate.The installation crew was very experienced, prompt, courteous, clean and tidy.I would highly recommend this company to those looking to go solar and battery.
They helped me through the whole process and provided me with all in information that I was after.

We received two good quotes for the solar installation on the same day as our request via Solar Quotes. We selected Green Vision Solar on the basis of the length of the guarantee period.GVS were quick and efficient in the pre-install set-up. The equipment was delivered two days prior to the planned install date. The installation team arrived on the promised date, and worked safely and efficiently. The installation is neat, and the work area was tidied up at the finish. We had spare roof tiles available, but none were needed.GVS arranged the grid connection, which took place really quickly.The GVS technician downloaded an energy management portal and showed us how to use it.In subsequent days we reported to GVS that the inverter was showing a "warning" indication. This was quickly attended to.The system is now fully functional. As with all new tools, we need to learn how to use it.
The guys were so communicative - made the whole process for solar on our house very straight forward.  Installation team were also on time and efficient.
Oliver and the team did a great job installing 13.3kW of solar and a 10kW Sungrow battery for a fantastic price.

Sales quoting and on-site inspection timelyInstallation team very polite, today and punctual. They seemed like a very young Cohesive teamCS helped to organise Grid connection  after install but needed prompting  how to sync and use the mobile app.

Green Vision Solar provided a seamless process from beginning to end! The customer service was great, the communication was fantastic and the job was done with care. The team left our house spotless.  Can’t recommend them enough!!

All three quotations were very professional. Offer to source any needed tiles sealed the deal. A very professional, safety conscious and efficient crew of installers (led by Leigh) with a very tidy result going the extra step to connect to www by ethernet cable rather than wifi. Salesman (Oliver) continued to be available through the installation and after the installation to answer & resolve any queries.Grid connection is pending.
Yes - the process was well explained from the start of the initial process to the final installation.Every step of the way we felt well supported and informed.
We found Green Vision Solar very thorough and professional in the quoting, communication and delivery of our solar upgrade. The electrical contractor was also quick, efficient and helpful.

Very impressed with all aspects of the process. They were polite, professional and very very clever! They answered all my stupid questions were exceptionally neat and did not leave any mess. I cannot speak highly enough of the Dynamic Duo. Even the inspector Irish James was a real darling. I would not hesitate to recommend GREEN VISION.

We purchased a Sonnen Evo battery because it was the best configuration, capacity and value. This was added to an existing 10 YO PV system. The sale process was a little protracted because of site complications. Green Vision Solar seemed most clearly onto the issues and agreed to organise the relocation of a gas water heater.The installation itself was straightforward and prompt even with a delay for a plumber to attend. An inspector attended within a few days and was complimentary about the quality of the installation.So far, the battery appears to be performing as expected. The Sonnen app installed easily and is very informative. We hope that if problems occur, we will have suitable support.

The sales quoting process was excellent. After approval, I did not receive a hello. I guessed it was busy after new year. When it was finally installed after my follow ups, I have to say hello again. After 2 weeks it was checked and turned on. I had to update them. Up to now waiting for certificate and hopefully hear from them soon next week so we can finally use it.

We live in a townhouse and Oliver was the first person at a company we’ve spoken to who was very realistic about the amount of panels that would fit on our roof (able to squeeze in 14, and if you live in a townhouse a site visit might be a good idea for precise measurements).They were also able to offer whichever brand of panels (I started off requesting Trina but we went with Jinko as they are a bit more suitable for varied roofing).I would suggest insisting on an installation date before transferring a deposit, as it was quite a while after what had been discussed on the phone in the end (given this was in November of course some leeway is understandable, especially as STCs reduce at the end of the year).On the day Leigh and the team were straight up on the roof and for a pretty tricky install were done by about 3:30.I was very impressed that everything was cleaned up, all packaging, broken tiles and rubbish included.We only waited five days after install for the inspector (which was very pleasantly below the 10-15 days I was advised might be the case). There was a minor issue with one connection cable to the inverter so only two sets of panels were able to be turned on immediately. Leigh the installer was back less than 24 hours after this was identified and the issue was fixed within ten minutes.4/5 for Customer Service as was unable to reach someone on the business landline when I tried on several occasions, but responses by text are pretty good, with emails also responded to quickly.This review has been done before connection to the grid, which is expected to take a while.

All providers were prompt with their quotes and contact. We chose Green Vision Solar on equipment being used. Oliver from Green Vision was very helpful and discussed the system, addressed our concerns and provided sound advice without pushing or trying to upsell.
Great professional installation. Would recommend this electrician to others in the Bendigo and Northern Victoria region.

The quoting process was made easier as they supplied google photos of our roof and showed us where they’d place solar panels. We had questions as this is completely new to us and team leader came to our home and explained everything. Communication from whole team was fantastic and timely and installers came at exactly when they said. The office team coordinated everything which was a relief to us.
Green Vision Solar did a fantastic job.From the start to finish the whole process was worry free.I would recommend Green Vision Solar for your home solar system.

Everything from the quotes and options available, pricing, advice in regard to rebates, forms that needed to be filled in, inspector arriving, system going live has all been seamless.Installation was professional, very neat and tidy workmanship, and workers were very polite and helpful.Backup service and advice has been very good as we needed to remove an old system before installing the new one.
As it has not yet been signed off , the process is incomplete.
Happy with the process from start to finish. Good quote, easy install, no hassle.

The quoting process was seamless. The installers were prompt, polite and professional. There was a slight issue with the number of screw points  on the roof but  a solution was quickly found at no extra cost so that's always a win.

I got three quotes. GVS was the best price for a 20Kw system and a Tesla power wall 3.Oliver was very easy to deal with and the whole install was done quickly and I was kept in the loop the whole time.Thanks!
Excellent clean install, friendly helpful staff. Would happily use againArrived when they said they would and got my system installed quickly and a very neat and tidy job.

Oliver came across as a good communicator and he gave me a competitive price.Leigh the installer is very professional and has a good work ethic. Despite not getting it right the first time due to a bit more complexity of my installation, he was happy to get to the bottom of it to make it work. (Working after hour)I would have given a five star for installation if it had worked the first time.Work is tidy! No mess! No rubbish left behind.Thank you Finn, your videos were helpful and your recommendations are splendid.

The team at Green Vision Solar were fantastic, they talked us through the various systems and installation options we had and then provided us with some work around on the day of installation to ensure we still got the best value for our system.

Ollie and his team did a fantastic job. The time between our initial enquiry through to final installation was super fast and everyone of the trades involved were friendly and efficient. Thank you Green Vision Solar!

I wanted to upgrade the crappy solar system I had on my roof. Did a lot of SolarQuotes viewing (watched every episode they’ve ever published on YouTube) so I knew what I had, needed and could speak upon.  Oliver and his team were responsive, helpful and the office support guided me through the multiple applications required for an upgraded 8 kW inverter, 24 new panels (including the East and South roof sides) and 16 kWh batteries. The problem with the battery placement was solved very quickly and to my great satisfaction. My 10.56 kW solar system was up and running within 2 working days due to their collaborative relationship with the inspector.  They even set up the new SunGrow app for me (of which I’m addicted to monitoring).  I do not hesitate in recommending GREEN VISION SOLAR if you are in Victoria. Especially if you are in the Eastern suburbs as their office and warehouse is close by and I think got me in quicker than usual. GO GREEN!  GO GREEN VISION SOLAR.

My initial contact with them was promising. His quote was comparable to other installers, but he stood out by being initially very helpful and receptive over the phone.The first red flag appeared when no one wanted to visit the site. When I questioned this, I was assured it wasn’t necessary.The problems escalated when I was sent a payment link for the deposit. After paying, I noticed a 2.5% processing fee was deducted. Had I paid the full amount upfront, the fee would have exceeded $200. When I raised this, I was told the payment couldn’t be reversed and was advised to read the terms and conditions. My response was, "But you sent me the payment link—your recommended portal." I received no reply.After the deposit was paid, communication dropped off entirely. The day before installation, I couldn’t reach anyone by phone or email, despite my concerns about the plumber’s lack of knowledge regarding the hot water system installation. Multiple emails requesting the plumber’s contact information and scheduling details went unanswered. When the plumber arrived, no one was on site to meet him, and I lacked his contact info. As a result, he began the job blindly. My wife had to take time off work to check on the installation, only to find that he had unnecessarily piped the hot water around the entire house instead of using a nearby water source. This caused a significant drop in our water pressure, requiring another plumber to fix the issue.They visited the site after I disputed the plumber's overcharge for copper and mentioned the poor installation quality. He promised to resolve it, but I never heard back.After the hot water system was installed, three of the plumber's fittings leaked significantly, necessitating further repairs.When the solar installers arrived, I asked about the plan the team and I had agreed on, particularly concerning the impact of nearby trees on solar efficiency. The installer informed me that the plans wouldn’t work, and they were doing something entirely different, which he claimed was standard. He quickly sketched the new setup on the side of a cardboard box, leaving me unsure if the installation was done correctly.The solar meter reconfiguration was repeatedly rejected by the energy company due to incorrect paperwork from GVS. I spent weeks being passed around on the phone, trying to resolve the issue. Now, months later, GVS’s incorrect paperwork has reclassified my meter as commercial, preventing me from switching energy plans. The power company has been trying to fix this for three weeks.Overall; The initial quoting was helpful, but once in the system it was a cookie cutter, rushed install with a lot of stress and ongoing issues.

Oliver of Green Vision Solar made the entire process from start to finish exceptionally easy. Good quality panels and inverter at fair market prices. Extremely knowledgeable and helpful office staff to guide you through the Govt process.The installation crew are second to none, well presented, well spoken, they arrived early each day and worked consistently. Premium quality installation displaying extensive experience and knowledge. Job site/our home was left clean, tidy and all rubbish was taken away.Thank you to everyone involved, fantastic work.Paul Gabriel of Dartmouth

I conducted a lot of research before selecting Green Vision Solar and based on that research I was highly confident that I made the right choice.  Even then, Oliver at Green Vision Solar and his team exceeded expectations and I am very happy with the result.  I highly recommend them

Very smooth experience with Green Vision Solar. From providing a competitive quote to a fast hassle free installation including a thourough clean up, they made the process of acquiring solar easy.The installation crew were professional, tidy, curteous and completed the installation within one day.

From start to finish, nothing but professional service provided.  The guys installing the system were very quick, helpful with any questions I had and cleaned up after themselves.  I've just had the system approved and the technician making the approval was also impressed with the quality of the fit out.I have no concerns with providing a glowing reference for the company, from quotation, installation and final approval.  So happy I don't have to deal with getting it onto the grid, they are looking after it all.  This makes it all so much easier and I thank them for their service.

Really did a great job with the installation.From quote and deposit they booked me in within about a month, and it was installed within a day.The generation and advice they provided was as expected and have had no issues so far.Thanks to Oliver and the team at Green Vision Solar!

Oliver from Green Vision responded quickly to the quote request and provided a good value quote, that also included an EV car charger. The other quotes I received were more expensive, and the customer service was not very good.The installation was done quickly and the installers were tidy and polite. They also and connected the inverter to the wifi and registered the device with Goodwe.Green Vision have organized the solar inspection, and will facilitate the grid connection with our supplier.I am very happy with the installation so far.

I wholeheartedly recommend Oliver and his team as a solar panel provider. It has been an excellent customer experience, which can not be beaten by any other provider on the market. From the outset, Oliver has individualised his approach to meet the customer requirements of tight schedules and deadlines within her own workload and her family circumstances. His rates are the most competitive in the market.  Oliver has been patient with the timeframe for installation and not once placed any selling pressure to purchase solar panels from his company.His staff are absolutely outstanding with fantastic interpersonal skills and the frequent update on the day - of the progress occurring. The icing on the cake was their fastidiousness in maintaining a clean, neat and organised worksite. I heartily recommend Oliver and his team as a provider of solar panel installation.

Competition is strong but oliver stood out from the rest.All questions were answered instantly and honestly.The process was easy from consultation to installation. The office staff were a pleasure to deal with and the installers were very professional.Installation is neat. Could not be happier10/10

Thank you to Oliver and his team. From the very first conversation, Oliver was very informative and answered every question I had. He explained the process and provided a very competitive quote.Thanks Oliver, will definitely be referring you to my family and friends

The salesperson was very engaging, offering a good price and thoroughly explaining the installation process over the phone. The installation was completed quickly, which seemed almost too good to be true—and unfortunately, it was.Within hours, the system disconnected from the home Wi-Fi and wouldn't reconnect on its own. When I called the salesperson, he claimed my home Wi-Fi was inadequate, despite my phone showing a strong continuous signal at the inverter. After some persistence, he reluctantly provided the manufacturer's national support number in Sydney. While waiting, a quick Google search showed me how to reconnect the system to the Wi-Fi, which was surprisingly easy. However, the data displayed in the app was highly inaccurate.Meanwhile, a regulator inspected the installation and found several mistakes. I hoped the faulty data was one of them, but it wasn't. The installer returned to fix his mistakes pointed out by the regulator. Reluctantly contacting the salesperson again, he agreed to send another technician. This sub-contracted technician seemed knowledgeable and promptly resolved the problem. The next day a technician from a different company arrived to fix the problem that had already been fixed! If it doesn't rain, it pours...And while all the was happening, the admin side of things had its own issues. Soon after the installation the energy distributor emailed and texted me to say that a connection application had been submitted. I queried the installation company salesperson who told me this was a mistake and that he would cancel this erroneous application and that I should ignore any future communications on this matter. Two weeks later another staff member of the installation company asked me for serial numbers of the installed equipment for a connection application. It surprised me that the installation company and three different technicians hadn't bothered to collect any serial numbers.In summary, this installation company offers a good price for a good product but expect zero after-sales service and a problematic installation.

All aspects of the sales / quotes / purchase / install and connection process went without a hitch. For technical reasons we had a change of inverter brand at the last minute and it was no hassle at all. The installation process was smooth and delivered as promised. I'd highly recommend.
The subcontractors were polite and tidy.The post installation paperwork was handled by the company.The inverter was put where we wanted it.

All commitments met or exceeded, pleasant and informative dealings, very reasonable pricing. Very professional install team. No hidden costs, better overall experience than I expected. Well done guys.
Quoting was a smooth process, didn't feel pushed, the install was done over 2 days due to weather, the customer service was great helped the whole way through even on a Sunday.

I wanted a fair bit of information about our requirements and installation practicalities but Oliver was patient and available to sort things out.Installation was delayed through no fault of Green Vision but they completed the job very satisfactorily.

I recently had a solar installation done by Green Vision Solar, and I couldn't be more satisfied. From the initial consultation to the final connection, their team was professional, knowledgeable, and efficient. The installation process was smooth, and they kept me informed at every step. The quality of the solar panels is excellent, and I cant stop looking at my roof! Ive already noticed a significant reduction in my energy bills. Overall, I highly recommend Green Vision Solar for their top-notch service and expertise in solar solutions. It's a solid 10 out of 10!

I went through a lot of different quotes with Green Vision Solar and they were very patient and understanding and gave me good advice around which system to go for. I felt they gave me great value for money. I did go for the 10kW system given their advice and I’m very happy that I followed their advice.The installers were great. They got on with the job, no cracked tiles and were very polite. We did have some teething issues once the installation was completed but after a quick call back to them, they sent someone straight out to fix up the issue.They did set up the connection to the grid on my behalf making everything simple and straight forward for myself.I would and have recommended them to friends and family.

Daniel & the team from Green Vision Solar were amazing to deal with from their first quote & site inspection all the way thru to the installation was first class.With many other cheap, no frills installers (cowboys) out there it was a no brainer to go with Green Vision with their great customer service & quality of work.Would highly recommend them to anyone thinking of getting Solar.
Process from start to finish was good. Installers were professional, customer service was great

Excellent service from quoting to final commissioningWorkers were on time and efficient at their jobs.The only extra cost was replacing the power switchboard as the original was already at capacity.This was an expected cost so we had allowed for that.We are just waiting on our power supplier to connect us to the grid.

Oliver was great to deal with, talked me out of a battery at the moment as they don't pay for themselves. Quotes came through quickly.Rebates were easy to get with links provided.Install took a few days due to the glorious Melbourne weather, guys did a great job and everything looks neat and tidy, only needed a few replacement tiles which I had (my roof tiles are utter crap) and break if you sneeze at them wrong).
Very happy with the service. Installation was completed on time. Clear information provided by the installers.

Oliver was prompt at replying during the quote process and well informed. Very competitive pricing. Installation was promptly arranged.The subcontractor used by Green Vision Solar arrived on the day and promptly installed the system including a difficult DC run. We were very happy with the installation process, and it was all done on the same dayThe inspection process was a bit frustrating with a wide time frame given and multiple changed appointments without any notification - though this is through an independent person so relatively out of their control.Now we're left just awaiting the grid connection.
The boys at Green vision were wonderful to deal with. Very informative and helpful with fast punctual installation.
Easy communication and always kept updated. Installation arranged 1 week after paying deposit and heat pump HWS also organised and done same day. Everything organised, connected up and working well.

Been a delight to deal with from the rep Oliver to the guys that did the install. Went seamlessly and team was helpful in any questions ask . Can honestly say if you go with Green Vision you won’t look back.
Fantastic easy clean helpful courteous knowledgeable people from quote to grid connection.  Could not have wished for better service.  Thank you Oliver, Mat, Mathew, Nick, Raoul, Jack and everyone A+

Green vision solar did an awesome job, Oliver and his crew are very good at there job, great knowledge about the product they install. Showed up on time and got the job done without any problems and cleaned up afterwards . Very Happy with my Green vision solar system. Highly recommended. Thanks again GREEN VISION SOLAR..
First company to reply, great communication, no problem too big, installation was completed within hours, ongoing customer support AAA

The price was good and the installation went off without any problem. They arrived when they said they would and did the job as far as I'm aware. I haven't been on the roof to look at it though.However I can't recommend their customer service. Getting connected to the grid took a long time because Green Vision sent the paperwork to a retailer I was longer buying my electricity from. They didn't explicitly ask me which retailer I was currently buying my electricity from in order to send the paperwork for grid connection to the right place. They assumed I was still using a previous retailer who I had to change from because they went out of business.Also I am currently trying to get my monitoring set up. I have a Fronius inverter with a consumption monitor but have had minimal assistance to set up the Fronius tools to monitor consumption. Currently I am only able to see generation not consumption. Green Vision are difficult to contact on the phone and the last message I received from them was to contact Fronius. I don't think the job is complete until I have all of the tools I paid for working and I'm currently having to research setting things up myself by Youtube videos. This makes me concerned that if something were to go wrong with the system in the future, Green Vision would not be there to fix it.

Green Vision Solar did a great job installing our 10kW solar system. Oliver did a great job quoting and explaining the design. Four weeks after we signed up the installation was completed, much quicker than we expected in the current environment. The technicians doing the install were great. Electrical inspection completed, just waiting for the feed tariff to be setup with our retailer.

We had our 10:45kw solar system installed last week by Green Vision Solar. We would especially like to commend Aziz & Oliver as they provided exemplary customer service and answered all our questions professionally and promptly. The process was seamless,timely and efficient.The cost of our system was also a bonus in comparison to other quotes for a smaller system that we sought prior to going ahead with Green Vision Solar.Very happy with the installation technicians, they too; were fantastic to deal with and very polite, respectful and professional. I would highly recommend Green Vision Solar to anyone who is interested in having a solar system installed.

Oliver was really helpful planning our system, and was very forthcoming with prices for different brands and configurations. The quoting process was very relaxed (no hard sell), and Oliver left room to change the brands or configuration even after I'd accepted the quote.Installation was organised within a week of accepting the quote. Matthew showed up on time and explained the installation process clearly. The entire installation was completed within a day. The install itself is really clean, and not a single broken roof tile. System was inspected and switched on a week after installation, and the inspector said it was very neat.Green Vision have arranged grid connection but I am waiting on my energy retailer to progress this. From my experience so far, I have little doubt that Green Vision will resolve any issues that might arise.

The end to end process was excellent, from quoting to implementation.Oliver provided excellent support throughout and answered my questions.The installation was very professional and clean, no issues when inspected.From the service and value for money perspectives, Green Vision Solar is local, and highly recommended.

I shopped around a fair bit. Green Vision beat about 6 others. Good price, knowledgeable and easy to deal with. Good communications, crystal clear on the process. Oliver is a top bloke!Installers were early to their appointment. It was soon clear they knew what they were doing. Friendly, very professional. Install an inverter and 25 panels in about 6hrs.Waiting on final signoff, but so far, so good! Very happy!

Thankyou solar quotes for doing the hard work and finding quality, reliable solar installers.Waited for three quotes but only ended up being contacted by two companies.  The second would not confirm they could put in a 3-phase system to support the existing air conditioner so went with the first quote.Suspect the first quote grossly overestimated how quickly the system would pay for itself, but time will tell.Over 12 weeks from deposit to installation seemed slow but just 11 days from installation to being connected to the grid (with only a couple of signatures from myself) was impressive.On the day installers were punctual and professional.  Love the linked SEMS app which shows so far today the system has generated 60.8kWh.
They came on time and had additional installers and put uo 32 panels in 4 hours with a 10kw inverterI would recommend them
One of only a couple of suppliers who were willing to quote a south-facing roof.Installation crew were great and were even noted by my sparky neighbour for how efficient they were.
Smooth experience from quote, booking to install. Did exactly what they said they would and on time. So far so good!

I highly recommend Green Vision Solar. Oliver has been friendly, helpful & efficient from start to finish. I was impressed with his knowledgeable advice and the quote was icing on the cake. Also pat on the back to the install team. The boys were prompt, quiet & respectful. Heads down & got the job done. Zero mess left behind (I think they left my yard tidier than how they found it). Don’t even bother comparing other solar installers. Green Vision Solar is definitely the only one to use. Oliver gets my vote!!

The sales and quote process was pretty good. A good quote the first time, where with other suppliers it felt like a game to them.Our installer was pretty good.The customer service was ok, I had to push a few times to get the various after install things done.
